global_components.title: Global Components
global_components.button_desc: Buttons trigger an action or navigation with a single tap.
global_components.icon_button_desc: Icon-only button for compact actions (toolbar, table row action, card action). Same style semantics as Button.
global_components.fab_desc: Floating Action Button — the single most prominent action on a screen. Always circular, always elevated with shadow, icon-only.
global_components.button_group_desc: Layout patterns for action button pairs (secondary + primary). Choose based on context: Justify for dialogs, Start/End/Center for inline forms, Stack for narrow/mobile.
global_components.input_desc: Text input field for forms: label, value/placeholder, helper or error text, optional leading/trailing icon.
global_components.select_desc: Dropdown select a single value from list. Same height scale as Input field (36/40/48px).
global_components.search_desc: Search input with fixed leading search icon and a clear (x) button that appears when filled. Same height scale as Input (36/40/48px).
global_components.textarea_desc: Multi-line input for longer content (description, notes, comments). Fixed min-height 96px.
global_components.checkbox_desc: Select multiple independent options. Indeterminate used when a sub-group is partially selected.
global_components.radio_desc: Select exactly one option from a mutually exclusive set.
global_components.switch_desc: Toggle a single setting on/off, takes effect immediately (unlike Checkbox which is typically submitted with a form).
global_components.slider_desc: Select a numeric value within a range by dragging. Shown at 50% value.
global_components.menu_item_desc: A single row inside a dropdown / context menu. Selected shows a leading checkmark; optional trailing keyboard shortcut.
global_components.tab_item_desc: A single tab in a horizontal nav (top nav / section tabs). Active state shows an underline indicator.
global_components.nav_bar_desc: Top navigation header composing brand name/logo, navigation tabs, and actions (icon button, action button).
global_components.side_nav_item_desc: A single item inside a vertical sidebar navigation. Active uses a filled background + brand color instead of an underline.
global_components.bottom_tab_item_desc: A single tab in a mobile app bottom navigation bar. Icon stacked above label, composing the full bottom tab bar.
global_components.top_app_bar_desc: Top app bar for mobile screens: back navigation, screen title, and trailing actions.
global_components.action_sheet_desc: Bottom sheet menu for mobile: drag handle, actions list, and cancel button.
global_components.badge_desc: Small status/category label. Uses subtle background tokens so it never competes with primary content.
global_components.card_desc: Composite card container: image media, badge, title, description, and action buttons.
global_components.avatar_desc: User avatar with fallback initials and optional online status dot indicator.
global_components.alert_desc: Inline notification banner (distinct from floating Toast). 4 semantic styles with optional close button.
global_components.tooltip_desc: Short hint shown on hover. Uses inverse background so it stands out on any surface.
global_components.modal_desc: Confirmation dialog, composed of Icon Button (close) + Button Group (Justify) for footer.
global_components.modal_sample_desc: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete the project and remove all associated data.
global_components.accordion_desc: Collapsible sections for grouped content (FAQ, settings). Chevron rotates 180° when expanded.
global_components.accordion_item_desc: This is the expandable content area. It can contain any text, list, or nested component.
global_components.pagination_desc: Page navigation control: previous/next icon buttons + page number items with ellipsis for long ranges.
global_components.breadcrumb_desc: Navigation trail showing current page location within a hierarchy. Current is active and not a link.
global_components.stepper_desc: A single step in a multi-step flow (checkout, onboarding). Completed shows a checkmark instead of the step number.
global_components.progress_bar_desc: Linear progress indicator for uploads, task completion, etc. Shown at 60% with optional label.
global_components.table_desc: Data table composed of existing components: Checkbox for row select, Avatar + text for name, Badge for status, Icon Button for row actions.
global_components.divider_desc: Separates content or sections. Horizontal, Vertical, or Horizontal with a centered label (e.g. "OR").
global_components.chip_desc: Interactive selectable pill for filters or tag input (unlike Badge, which is display-only). Selected shows a leading checkmark. Optional trailing close/remove icon.
